name: Beijing Geekplus Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Geekplus Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the sales, installation, and commissioning of robot products in Mainland China, the United States, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific. The company engages in the production of robots, as well as sales robotics solutions. It offers solutions, including shelf-to-person, tote-to-person, pallet-to-person, robot arm picking, sorting, and intralogistics solutions.
